# TheTransitionZone

> Community-driven hub for honest pickleball paddle reviews. The trusted source for what's in your bag, community-verified, durability-tracked, no brand bias, no paid scores. Currently a pre-launch landing page collecting interest emails and creator partnership requests.

TheTransitionZone is a structured, neutral source for pickleball paddle reviews. The brand promise is honest information: every review is tied to a verified owner, reviewers earn trust over time, and brands cannot pay to influence rankings. The platform is in active development. The page at this URL is a placeholder where visitors can register their email to be notified when the site launches, and where creators can opt in to a partnership conversation.

## Key features

- Find your next paddle. Filter by play style, level, budget, and the dimensions players care about (control, power, spin, touch). Every paddle is scored on the dimensions that matter, ranked by what verified owners at your level actually say.
- Community-verified reviews. Every review is tied to a verified owner. Reviewers earn trust over time, with weight given to those whose past scores correlate with the community consensus. Experts and creators have a separate, transparent tier so their voices are visible without polluting the community score.
- Durability check-ins. The platform pings owners at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months to capture how a paddle is holding up: edge guard wear, dead spots, performance drift. These check-ins produce the only honest durability rating in pickleball.
- Your bag and head-to-head compare. Every user keeps a public bag of every paddle they have owned, including retired ones. Any two paddles can be compared head to head on every spec, score, and dimension.
- No brand bias, no paid scores. Brands cannot pay to climb the rankings, weight scores, or remove negative reviews. Any ads or partnerships are clearly labelled and never alter community scores.
- Creator partnerships. Creators can opt in to be contacted about featuring their reviews and lab data alongside community ratings. Creator content is always labelled and never counts toward a paddle's score, keeping the community signal clean.

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://thetransitionzone.app/): single scroll page with nav, hero ("What's in your bag?"), four feature sections, a final CTA, and footer. Two email forms (hero + final CTA), both posting to Formspree, both with a creator opt-in checkbox.

## Status

Pre-launch. Email signups post to Formspree; submissions where the creator opt-in is ticked include a flag the form owner uses to filter partnership candidates from the regular interest list. The full site is under active development. Launch date is to be announced; subscribers on the interest list will be notified when the platform goes live.
